1. What Amari does

Amari suggests dinners from what's already in your kitchen. It can recognise foods in photos, plan your week, build a shopping list, answer cooking questions ("Ask Amari"), and write recipes for dishes the collection doesn't have. Some features use artificial intelligence (AI).

2. Who can use Amari

  • You must be at least 13 years old (16 in the EU, EEA and UK, unless your country sets a lower age with parental consent).
  • If you're under the age of majority where you live, a parent or guardian must agree to these Terms for you.
  • You must not use Amari if the law forbids you from doing so.

3. Accounts

  • You can use Amari without an account. Some features, such as scanning, create a guest ID on our servers.
  • An account (email, Sign in with Apple or Google sign-in) lets you keep your information across devices.
  • Keep your sign-in details secure. You're responsible for what happens under your account.
  • You can delete your account at any time in the app: You → Privacy and data → Delete account.

4. Price: Amari is free

  • Amari, including every Amari Plus feature, is currently free for everyone. No payment details are needed.
  • Features are subject to fair-use limits that keep the Service available and affordable, for example a number of scans per day, Ask Amari messages per month and new recipes per month. The app tells you when you reach a limit, and limits reset automatically.
  • If we introduce paid plans in future, we'll tell you in the app before anything changes. Features you're using won't be taken away without notice. Nothing will be charged unless you choose to buy it.
  • If paid subscriptions are offered in the iPhone app, they'll be sold through Apple's In-App Purchase. Before you buy, the app will show the price, the billing period and what's included. Subscriptions renew automatically unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, in your Apple Account settings, where you can also manage or cancel them. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. Refunds are handled by Apple under its policies.

6. Food, allergies and safety

This is the most important section. Please read it.

  • Check labels and ingredients yourself. Recipes, products and brands vary. Always read product labels, especially for allergens such as peanuts, tree nuts, milk, eggs, wheat or gluten, soy, sesame, fish and shellfish, and for cross-contamination warnings.
  • Allergy and diet settings are a guide, not a guarantee. Amari leaves out dishes that break your rules and checks AI replies against them, but it can't guarantee that any recipe, suggestion or answer is free of an allergen or suitable for your diet. If you have a severe allergy, don't rely on Amari alone.
  • AI can be wrong. Food recognition can miss or misidentify items. Ask Amari's answers and recipes Amari writes are generated by AI and may be inaccurate, incomplete or unsafe. Use your own judgement.
  • Cook safely. Check that meat, poultry, fish and eggs are cooked to safe temperatures, follow safe food storage and handling, and take care with knives, heat and appliances. Use-by estimates are guesses; check your food before eating it.
  • Nutrition figures are estimates. Calories, protein and other numbers are approximate and may be wrong.
  • Not medical advice. Amari doesn't diagnose, treat or give advice about any medical, nutritional or dietary condition, including eating disorders, diabetes, pregnancy or medication interactions. Talk to a doctor or registered dietitian about your health, before starting a weight goal, and before changing your diet.
  • In an emergency, such as a severe allergic reaction, call your local emergency number.

7. AI features

  • Ask Amari, food recognition and recipe writing use third-party AI services, described in our Privacy Policy. The app asks for your permission before it first sends your information to them.
  • You're responsible for what you ask. Don't enter information you don't want processed by an AI service, such as other people's personal details or medical records.
  • AI output may resemble content elsewhere. Recipes Amari writes may be saved, without your name, and offered to other people who ask for the same dish, and may join Amari's recipe collection.
  • Don't use AI features to produce content that is unlawful, harmful, deceptive or that breaks section 9.
